+// Package store is an in-memory inventory store.
+package store
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"sort"
+	"sync"
+)
+
+var ErrNotFound = errors.New("item not found")
+
+type Store struct {
+	mu    sync.RWMutex
+	items map[string]Item
+}
+
+func New() *Store { return &Store{items: map[string]Item{}} }
+
+// Get returns the item stored under sku.
+func (s *Store) Get(ctx context.Context, sku string) (Item, error) {
+	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+		return Item{}, err
+	}
+	s.mu.RLock()
+	defer s.mu.RUnlock()
+	it, ok := s.items[sku]
+	if !ok {
+		return Item{}, ErrNotFound
+	}
+	return it, nil
+}
+
+func (s *Store) Put(it Item) {
+	s.mu.Lock()
+	defer s.mu.Unlock()
+	s.items[it.SKU] = it
+}
+
+func (s *Store) Delete(sku string) bool {
+	s.mu.Lock()
+	defer s.mu.Unlock()
+	_, ok := s.items[sku]
+	delete(s.items, sku)
+	return ok
+}
+
+// List returns all items ordered by SKU.
+func (s *Store) List() []Item {
+	s.mu.RLock()
+	defer s.mu.RUnlock()
+	out := make([]Item, 0, len(s.items))
+	for _, it := range s.items {
+		out = append(out, it)
+	}
+	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].SKU < out[j].SKU })
+	return out
+}

+package store
+
+import (
+	"context"

+)
+
+func TestGetPut(t *testing.T) {
+	s := New()
+	s.Put(Item{SKU: "A", Name: "anchor", Qty: 1})
+	it, err := s.Get(context.Background(), "A")
+	if err != nil || it.Name != "anchor" {
+		t.Fatalf("Get = %v, %v", it, err)
+	}
+	if _, err := s.Get(context.Background(), "missing"); !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
+		t.Fatalf("missing err = %v", err)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestGetCanceled(t *testing.T) {
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	cancel()
+	if _, err := New().Get(ctx, "A"); !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
+		t.Fatalf("err = %v", err)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestListSorted(t *testing.T) {
+	s := New()
+	for _, k := range []string{"c", "a", "b"} {
+		s.Put(Item{SKU: k})
+	}
+	got := s.List()
+	if got[0].SKU != "a" || got[2].SKU != "c" {
+		t.Fatalf("List = %v", got)
+	}
+	if !s.Delete("a") || s.Delete("a") {
+		t.Fatal("Delete semantics")
+	}
+}

+// Package util holds small shared helpers.
+package util
+
+// Clamp limits v to [lo, hi].
+func Clamp(v, lo, hi int) int {
+	if v < lo {
+		return lo
+	}
+	if v > hi {
+		return hi
+	}
+	return v
+}
+
+// Abs returns |v|.
+func Abs(v int) int {
+	if v < 0 {
+		return -v
+	}
+	return v
+}

+package util
+
+import "strings"
+
+// PadRight pads s with spaces to width w.
+func PadRight(s string, w int) string {
+	if len(s) >= w {
+		return s
+	}
+	return s + strings.Repeat(" ", w-len(s))
+}
+
+// Truncate shortens s to at most n bytes, adding "..." when cut.
+func Truncate(s string, n int) string {
+	if len(s) <= n {
+		return s
+	}
+	if n <= 3 {
+		return s[:n]
+	}
+	return s[:n-3] + "..."
+}

result.response:
### Cause of the Issue

In [warehouse.go](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-3823688284/acap-bench-545508244/errcatalog/warehouse.go#L11), the domain error key `"warehouse.limit"` was incorrectly mapped to [`api.CodeInternal`](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-3823688284/acap-bench-545508244/api/errors.go#L13) instead of [`api.CodeQuota`](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-3823688284/acap-bench-545508244/api/errors.go#L12). Because [`HTTPStatus`](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-3823688284/acap-bench-545508244/api/errors.go#L18-L30) translates [`api.CodeQuota`](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-3823688284/acap-bench-545508244/api/errors.go#L12) to `429 Too Many Requests` and defaults unrecognized / internal codes to `500 Internal Server Error`, capacity-limit errors from the warehouse domain were being returned as HTTP 500.

### Solution

1. In [warehouse.go](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-3823688284/acap-bench-545508244/errcatalog/warehouse.go#L11), updated `"warehouse.limit"` to map to [`api.CodeQuota`](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-3823688284/acap-bench-545508244/api/errors.go#L12).
2. In [catalog_test.go](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-3823688284/acap-bench-545508244/errcatalog/catalog_test.go#L16-L20), added `TestWarehouseLimit` to verify that `"warehouse.limit"` resolves to HTTP status 429.
